| `retries`                                                                               | [Optional[utils.RetryConfig]](../../models/utils/retryconfig.md)                        | :heavy_minus_sign:                                                                      | Configuration to override the default retry behavior of the client.                     |
| `server_url`                                                                            | *Optional[str]*                                                                         | :heavy_minus_sign:                                                                      | An optional server URL to use.                                                          |

## generate

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="containerImagesGenerate" method="post" path="/v1/images/generations" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.container.image.generate(
        prompt="An orange Lamborghini driving down a hill road at night with a beautiful ocean view in the background.",
        model="(adapter-route)",
        num_inference_steps=10,
        guidance_scale=3.5,
        control_images=[
            {
                "image": "https://huggingface.co/datasets/huggingface/documentation-images/resolve/main/diffusers/cat.png",
            },
        ],
    )

    # Handle response
    print(res)
```

## edit

Given an image and a description, the model edits the image.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="containerImagesEdit" method="post" path="/v1/images/edits" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.container.image.edit(
        image=[
            {
                "image": "https://huggingface.co/datasets/huggingface/documentation-images/resolve/main/diffusers/cat.png",
            },
        ],
        prompt="Add a red sports car in the foreground.",
        model="(adapter-route)",
        num_inference_steps=20,
        guidance_scale=0,
    )

    # Handle response
    print(res)
```

# Dedicated.Audio

## Overview

* [transcribe](#transcribe) - Audio transcriptions
* [stream](#stream) - Stream audio transcriptions

## transcribe

Given an audio file, the model transcribes it into text.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="dedicatedAudioTranscriptions" method="post" path="/dedicated/v1/audio/transcriptions" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.dedicated.audio.transcribe(
        model="(endpoint-id)",
        file={
            "file_name": "example.file",
            "content": open("example.file", "rb"),
        },
    )

    # Handle response
    print(res)
```

### Parameters

| Parameter                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Required                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Example                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | *str*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | :heavy_check_mark:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | ID of target endpoint. If you want to send request to specific adapter, use the format "YOUR_ENDPOINT_ID:YOUR_ADAPTER_ROUTE". Otherwise, you can just use "YOUR_ENDPOINT_ID" alone.                                                                                                                            | (endpoint-id)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `file`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | [models.DedicatedAudioTranscriptionBodyFile](../../models/dedicatedaudiotranscriptionbodyfile.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                              | :heavy_check_mark:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | The audio file object (not file name) to transcribe, in one of these formats: mp3, wav, flac, ogg, and many other standard audio formats.                                                                                                                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `x_friendli_team`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | *OptionalNullable[str]*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | :heavy_minus_sign:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | ID of team to run requests as (optional parameter).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `chunking_strategy`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | [OptionalNullable[models.DedicatedAudioTranscriptionBodyChunkingStrategy]](../../models/dedicatedaudiotranscriptionbodychunkingstrategy.md)                                                                                                                                                                    | :heavy_minus_sign:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Controls how the audio is cut into chunks. When set to `"auto"`, the server first normalizes loudness and then uses voice activity detection (VAD) to choose boundaries. `server_vad` object can be provided to tweak VAD detection parameters manually. If unset, the audio is transcribed as a single block. |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `language`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | *OptionalNullable[str]*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | :heavy_minus_sign:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | The language of the input audio. Supplying the input language in [ISO-639-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_639-1_codes) (e.g. `en`) format will improve accuracy and latency.                                                                                                                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `stream`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | *OptionalNullable[bool]*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | :heavy_minus_sign:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Whether to stream the transcription result. When set to `true`, the transcription result will be streamed as [server-sent events](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Server-sent_events/Using_server-sent_events#event_stream_format) once generated.                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `temperature`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | *OptionalNullable[float]*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | :heavy_minus_sign:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | The sampling temperature, between 0 and 1. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.                                                                                                                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `retries`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | [Optional[utils.RetryConfig]](../../models/utils/retryconfig.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | :heavy_minus_sign:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Configuration to override the default retry behavior of the client.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

## stream

Given an audio file, the model transcribes it into text.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="dedicatedAudioTranscriptionsStream" method="post" path="/dedicated/v1/audio/transcriptions#stream" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.dedicated.audio.stream(
        model="(endpoint-id)",
        file={
            "file_name": "example.file",
            "content": open("example.file", "rb"),
        },
        stream=True,
    )

    with res as event_stream:
        for event in event_stream:
            # handle event
            print(event, flush=True)
```

### Parameters

# Dedicated.Chat

Source: https://github.com/friendliai/friendli-python/blob/main/docs/sdks/dedicatedchat/README.md

# Dedicated.Chat

## Overview

### Available Operations

* [complete](#complete) - Chat completions
* [stream](#stream) - Stream chat completions

## complete

Given a list of messages forming a conversation, the model generates a response.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="dedicatedChatComplete" method="post" path="/dedicated/v1/chat/completions" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.dedicated.chat.complete(
        model="(endpoint-id)",
        messages=[
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "You are a helpful assistant.",
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "Hello!",
            },
        ],
    )

    # Handle response
    print(res)
```

                                          | Keeps only the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probabilities reach `top_p` or higher.                                                                                                                                                     | *OptionalNullable[float]*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | A probability threshold used to identify “top choice” tokens for exclusion in XTC (Exclude Top Choices) sampling. Tokens with probabilities at or above this threshold are considered viable candidates, and all but the least likely viable token are excluded from sampling. This option reduces the dominance of highly probable tokens while preserving some diversity by keeping the least confident “top choice.” Values range from 0.0 (inclusive) to 1.0 (inclusive). Higher values make the filtering more selective by requiring higher probabilities to trigger exclusion, while lower values apply filtering more broadly. The default value of 0.0 disables XTC filtering entirely.                                                                             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

Values range from 0.0 (inclusive) to 1.0 (inclusive), where 0.0 means XTC is never applied, 1.0 means XTC is always applied when viable tokens exist, and intermediate values provide probabilistic activation. ## stream

Given a list of messages forming a conversation, the model generates a response.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="dedicatedChatStream" method="post" path="/dedicated/v1/chat/completions#stream" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.dedicated.chat.stream(
        model="(endpoint-id)",
        messages=[
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "You are a helpful assistant.",
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "Hello!",
            },
        ],
        stream=True,
    )

    with res as event_stream:
        for event in event_stream:
            # handle event
            print(event, flush=True)
```

# Dedicated.ChatRender

Source: https://github.com/friendliai/friendli-python/blob/main/docs/sdks/dedicatedchatrender/README.md

# Dedicated.ChatRender

## Overview

### Available Operations

* [render](#render) - Chat render

## render

Given a list of messages forming a conversation, the API renders them into the final prompt text that will be sent to the model.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="dedicatedChatRender" method="post" path="/dedicated/v1/chat/render" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.dedicated.chat_render.render(
        model="(endpoint-id)",
        messages=[
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "You are a helpful assistant.",
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "Hello!",
            },
        ],
    )

    # Handle response
    print(res)
```

## stream

Generate text based on the given text prompt.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="dedicatedCompletionsStream" method="post" path="/dedicated/v1/completions#stream" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.dedicated.completions.stream(
        dedicated_completions_stream_body={
            "model": "(endpoint-id)",
            "stream": True,
            "prompt": "Say this is a test!",
        }
    )

    with res as event_stream:
        for event in event_stream:
            # handle event
            print(event, flush=True)
```

        image={
            "image": "https://huggingface.co/datasets/huggingface/documentation-images/resolve/main/diffusers/cat.png",
        },
        prompt="Add a red sports car in the foreground.",
        model="(endpoint-id)",
        num_inference_steps=20,

# Dedicated.Endpoint

## wandb_artifact_create

Create an endpoint from Weights & Biases artifact. If the idempotency key is provided, the API will check if the endpoint already exists, and rollout the existing endpoint if it does. In such cases, the project id must be provided.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="dedicatedEndpointWandbArtifactCreate" method="post" path="/dedicated/endpoint/wandb-artifact-create" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.dedicated.endpoint.wandb_artifact_create(
        wandb_artifact_version_name="org/registry/name:v0"
    )

    # Handle response
    print(res)
```

### Parameters

| Parameter                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Required                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `wandb_artifact_version_name`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | *str*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | :heavy_check_mark:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | The specific model artifact version from Weights & Biases. The referred artifact will be used to create a new endpoint in Friendli Dedicated Endpoints or rollout an existing one.                                                                                                                                         |
| `x_friendli_team`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | *OptionalNullable[str]*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | :heavy_minus_sign:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | ID of team to run requests as (optional parameter).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

## stream

Given an audio file, the model transcribes it into text.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="serverlessAudioTranscriptionsStream" method="post" path="/serverless/v1/audio/transcriptions#stream" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.serverless.audio.stream(
        model="openai/whisper-large-v3",
        file={
            "file_name": "example.file",
            "content": open("example.file", "rb"),
        },
        stream=True,
    )

    with res as event_stream:
        for event in event_stream:
            # handle event
            print(event, flush=True)
```

## complete

Given a list of messages forming a conversation, the model generates a response.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="serverlessChatComplete" method="post" path="/serverless/v1/chat/completions" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.serverless.chat.complete(
        model="zai-org/GLM-5.2",
        messages=[
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "You are a helpful assistant.",
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "Hello!",
            },
        ],
    )

    # Handle response
    print(res)
```

## stream

Given a list of messages forming a conversation, the model generates a response.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="serverlessChatStream" method="post" path="/serverless/v1/chat/completions#stream" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.serverless.chat.stream(
        model="zai-org/GLM-5.2",
        messages=[
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "You are a helpful assistant.",
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "Hello!",
            },
        ],
        stream=True,
    )

    with res as event_stream:
        for event in event_stream:
            # handle event
            print(event, flush=True)
```

| `top_p`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | *OptionalNullable[float]*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Keeps only the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probabilities reach `top_p` or higher. Values range from 0.0 (exclusive) to 1.0 (inclusive). The default value of 1.0 includes all tokens, allowing maximum diversity.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `xtc_threshold`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | *OptionalNullable[float]*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | :heavy_minus_sign:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | A probability threshold used to identify “top choice” tokens for exclusion in XTC (Exclude Top Choices) sampling. Tokens with probabilities at or above this threshold are considered viable candidates, and all but the least likely viable token are excluded from sampling. This option reduces the dominance of highly probable tokens while preserving some diversity by keeping the least confident “top choice.” Values range from 0.0 (inclusive) to 1.0 (inclusive). Higher values make the filtering more selective by requiring higher probabilities to trigger exclusion, while lower values apply filtering more broadly. The default value of 0.0 disables XTC filtering entirely.                                                                             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `xtc_probability`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | *OptionalNullable[float]*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | :heavy_minus_sign:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | The probability that XTC (Exclude Top Choices) filtering will be applied for each sampling decision. When XTC is triggered, high-probability tokens above the `xtc_threshold` are excluded except for the least likely viable token. This stochastic activation allows for a balance between standard sampling and creativity-boosting exclusion filtering. Values range from 0.0 (inclusive) to 1.0 (inclusive), where 0.0 means XTC is never applied, 1.0 means XTC is always applied when viable tokens exist, and intermediate values provide probabilistic activation. The default value of 0.0 disables XTC filtering.                                                                                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

# Serverless.ChatRender

Source: https://github.com/friendliai/friendli-python/blob/main/docs/sdks/serverlesschatrender/README.md

# Serverless.ChatRender

## Overview

### Available Operations

* [render](#render) - Chat render

## render

Given a list of messages forming a conversation, the API renders them into the final prompt text that will be sent to the model.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="serverlessChatRender" method="post" path="/serverless/v1/chat/render" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.serverless.chat_render.render(
        model="zai-org/GLM-5.2",
        messages=[
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "You are a helpful assistant.",
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "Hello!",
            },
        ],
    )

    # Handle response
    print(res)
```

## stream

Generate text based on the given text prompt.

### Example Usage

<!-- UsageSnippet language="python" operationID="serverlessCompletionsStream" method="post" path="/serverless/v1/completions#stream" example="Example" -->
```python
import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.serverless.completions.stream(
        serverless_completions_stream_body={
            "model": "meta-llama-3.1-8b-instruct",
            "stream": True,
            "prompt": "Say this is a test!",
        }
    )

    with res as event_stream:
        for event in event_stream:
            # handle event
            print(event, flush=True)
```

# Synchronous Example

Source: https://github.com/friendliai/friendli-python/blob/main/USAGE.md

<!-- Start SDK Example Usage [usage] -->
### Chat completions

Given a list of messages forming a conversation, the model generates a response.

```python
# Synchronous Example

import os

from friendli import SyncFriendli

with SyncFriendli(
    token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
) as friendli:
    res = friendli.serverless.chat.complete(
        model="zai-org/GLM-5.2",
        messages=[
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "You are a helpful assistant.",
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": "Hello!",
            },
        ],
    )

    # Handle response
    print(res)
```

</br>

The same SDK client can also be used to make asynchronous requests by importing asyncio.

```python
# Asynchronous Example
import asyncio
import os

from friendli import AsyncFriendli


async def main():
    async with AsyncFriendli(
        token=os.getenv("FRIENDLI_TOKEN", ""),
    ) as friendli:
        res = await friendli.serverless.chat.complete(
            model="zai-org/GLM-5.2",
            messages=[
                {
                    "role": "system",
                    "content": "You are a helpful assistant.",
                },
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": "Hello!",
                },
            ],
        )

        # Handle response
        print(res)


asyncio.run(main())
```
